review_candidates.description: Overall manage Corsair Design Systems Ltd's accounting and finance operation locally, be the contact point of 3rd party accounting firm, review journal entries and transactions and reporting, and assist Controller to improve internal controls for local operations, in line with Corporate Policies and Procedures and adhering to Local and US GAAP accounting standards.
